usedFor: Todoist holds tasks, and Smartcat sets a deadline on a translation task through “Set deadline for task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Incomplete Task” in Todoist, then “Set deadline for task” in Smartcat
bestTemplate.why: A new open task in Todoist can carry its due date over to the matching Smartcat task.

watchOut: “Delete the project” in Smartcat deletes a project, so keep it away from every new Todoist task.
